text:
maria_g: Heads up — qbringup for q6b-int4 next week. Need an updated promptset curation + golden refresh. TL;DR: sample 5k prompts (50/50 long/short), run dedupe, produce ~400 golden, and run a 1k quant-smoke.

alex_w: I can run the dedupe pipeline on staging. What fuzzy match threshold do we want? :thinking:

devin_k: Prefer tokenhash + sim threshold = 0.8. Keep near-duplicates in a separate bucket (flag as `near-dup`) instead of dropping them so we can analyze edgecase behavior.

kai_s: I’ll prep the holdout split and stub the eval harness. Do we need multilingual coverage for this bring-up?

maria_g: Yes — include en + es (~10% es). Seed the sampler for reproducibility. Golden labeling schema: 5-point quality scale, `hallucination` boolean, and an optional `severity` note. @labeler-bot assign when batch is ready.

labeler-bot: Assigned golden_batch_202403 -> curation-team. Estimated throughput: 25 labels/day. :robot_face:

alex_w: For dedupe let's run both exact fingerprint and sim-cluster. My plan: first pass exact hash, second pass faiss-based clustering (cosine >= 0.8). Will run on staging cluster now.

devin_k: SQL sample I used as a starter for the 5k:```sql
-- sample prod prompts
SELECT id, text, lang, created_at FROM prompts
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '90 days'
AND status = 'active'
ORDER BY random()
LIMIT 5000;
```

devin_k: Also generate token hashes with tokenizer v2 and include `tokenizer_version` in metadata. Reminder: tokenizers v2 changed normalization, so hash drift is possible.

kai_s: Eval harness will run these checks: consistency (exact-match threshold 0.6), factuality check (automated filter + human review for `hallucination=true`), and latency smoke for int4. I’ll add a multilang flag and a small subset for bleurt/bleu.

maria_g: Quant smoke plan: run q6b-int4 on a 1k random subset, compare outputs to fp16 baseline. Pass criteria: no more than 5% drop in 5-point mean score and no hallucination regression > 2x. Capture n-gram diffs and failure cases.

alex_w: Noted. I’ll push dedupe results + cluster IDs to S3 under `s3://redwood-curation/qbringup/1712224444/` and include a CSV with `prompt_id, cluster_id, fingerprint, near_dup_flag`.

devin_k: I’ll wire up RedMetrics dashboards: promptset hash, tokenizer_version, cluster distribution, golden label aggregates, and quant vs fp16 regression curves.

maria_g: Action items summary: 1) alex run dedupe & upload by EOD, 2) devin produce sample SQL, token hashes, and dash stubs, 3) kai prepare eval harness + holdout, 4) I’ll update golden labeling config and notify ops to bump labeler capacity if needed. Sync tomorrow 10:00am PT.

alex_w: :thumbsup: starting dedupe run now. I’ll ping if staging OOMs.

kai_s: Adding the 10:00am invite. Will include short demo of harness.

labeler-bot: curation-team acknowledged. Current queue length: 320. ETA for golden completion at 25/day: ~16 days (can scale if ops approves).

maria_g: ok thanks everyone — will post the final sampling artifact and golden config once ready.
